summary: Runway Growth Finance Corp., a Nasdaq-listed business development company, filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 24, 2026 for a $45.0 million offering of 7.75% notes due 2031, with a 30-day underwriters' option for an additional $6.8 million to cover overallotments. Oppenheimer & Co. Inc. acts as representative, joined by Runway Growth Capital LLC. The offering was made under an effective Form N-2 shelf registration statement via a September 24 prospectus supplement, with closing expected October 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch leverage and funding-cost trends.
